deltas.reason: For imaginary quadratic K, its Hilbert class field H is Galois over Q because conjugation preserves the maximal unramified abelian extension. An ideal-class element of Gal(H/K) is an actual automorphism fixing K. Finite Chebotarev over Q realizes it at a chosen prime above a rational prime split in K. Excluding finitely many prior primes gives distinct conjugate pairs representing the desired finite class generators.
deltas.set_shared_contract_justification: Both calls use finite Galois extensions over Q and actual compatible automorphisms. Here the finite extension is H/Q and the element lies in Gal(H/K); the chosen place selects the ideal-class representative. No independent component prescription or effective bound is added.
